components.name: Speed Dial
components.description: A floating button that fans out two to four actions when opened. Use it for the one main action of a view.

components.name: SplitButton
components.description: A main button with a caret beside it for its variants. Use it when there is a clear default action and a few alternatives.

components.name: Segmented
components.description: A short row of options where only one can be selected. Best for two to five choices that switch a view.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.description: Base UI's toggle group, composed from parts. Use it when the row needs multi-select or a shape `Segmented` doesn't cover.

components.name: Wizard
components.description: An ordered sequence of steps with the progress and navigation built in. Use it when a later step depends on an earlier one.

components.name: Button Group
components.description: Joins related buttons into one segmented control with shared borders.

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A square `Button` for a single icon. The `label` prop is required, since the icon carries no text.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A button that stays pressed, for on/off controls like bold or mute. Use `Switch` or `Checkbox` for values a form submits.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: A text input with suggestions, where the typed value doesn't have to come from the list. Use `Combobox` when it must.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: A month grid, built on react-day-picker. Use it when the reader needs to see the days; use `DatePicker` to just collect a date.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.description: Swatches for the brand palette with a hex field beside them. Pass `swatches` to narrow the choices.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: A text field that filters a list as you type and settles on one value. Use `Select` under about seven options.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: A field with a calendar in a popover, for picking one date.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.description: A start and end date picked in one calendar. The value is `{ from, to }`.

components.name: DateTimePicker
components.description: A calendar and a time picker combined into one `Date` value.

components.name: FileUpload
components.description: A drop zone that also works as a file button. `accept` filters the picker but is not validation — check the files again on `onFiles`.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.description: Several values from a fixed list, shown as removable chips. Use checkboxes under about five options.

components.name: NumberField
components.description: A numeric field with stepper buttons. The value is `number | null`, so an empty field is never mistaken for zero.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: One choice from a few, over native radio inputs. Best for two to five options; past that use `Select`.

components.name: Rating
components.description: A star scale, as an input or, with `readOnly`, as a display.

components.name: TagsInput
components.description: Free-form labels typed one at a time and shown as removable chips. Use `MultiSelect` when the list is fixed.

components.name: TimePicker
components.description: A time of day, from segmented hour and minute fields plus a dial. The value is `{ hours, minutes, seconds? }`, with no date attached.

components.name: Label
components.description: An accessible label for a control, paired with `htmlFor`. Use it when the label and the control are separate elements.

components.name: Form
components.description: The page-level `<form>` element and its vertical spacing. `Field` handles everything inside it.

components.name: Field Array
components.description: Repeated entries for an array of objects — one removable block each, with an add button under the stack.

components.name: Input OTP
components.description: A one-time-code field with one slot per character. Use it when the code length is fixed.

components.name: Phone Input
components.description: A country dial-code select next to a national-number field, returning one string like `+33612345678`.

components.name: Editable
components.description: Click-to-edit text: a preview that swaps to a field, saved on Enter or blur and discarded on Escape.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.description: A code snippet with a filename strip and a copy button.

components.name: DataTable
components.description: A table with sorting, selection, inline edit and paging, over `@tanstack/react-table`. Use `Table` when the rows only need displaying.

components.name: Tree
components.description: A nested, expandable hierarchy for files, org units or categories. Use a list with headings when the nesting is only grouping.

components.name: Item
components.description: A list row with media, content and action slots. Lighter than a `Card` for rows that repeat.

components.name: Marker
components.description: A small label pairing an icon with text, for titling a group of rows.

components.name: Snippet
components.description: A one-line copyable command or value. Use `Code Block` for multi-line samples.

components.name: QR Code
components.description: Renders a QR code as inline SVG. No dependency and no network — pass a `value`.

components.name: Meter
components.description: Shows how full something is within a known range, like disk or budget. Use `Progress` for work advancing towards done.

components.name: Relative Time
components.description: Renders "3 hours ago" from a date inside a `time` element, and keeps it updating. Past a week it shows the date instead.

examples.title: What a column can hand over

components.name: Command
components.description: The ⌘K palette: a filtered, grouped list of commands, built on `cmdk`.

components.name: Menubar
components.description: A desktop-style application menu bar — File, Edit, View — with keyboard traversal.

components.name: Navigation Menu
components.description: A horizontal site menu, with optional dropdown panels for richer links.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: The app's navigation column, composed from parts and nestable to any depth.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Sibling views of one subject, one visible at a time. Use `Wizard` for steps that have an order.

components.name: Tabs (composed)
components.description: Base UI's tabs, composed from parts instead of configured with an `items` array.

components.name: Toc
components.description: A sticky list of the sections on the current page, for jumping around a long document.

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.description: Holds content at a fixed width-to-height ratio, so the height follows the width.

components.name: Separator
components.description: A rule between content. Note Base UI's orientation semantics: a horizontal group takes vertical separators.

components.name: Scroll Area
components.description: A scrollable region with styled overlay scrollbars. The root needs a height to scroll inside.

components.name: Resizable
components.description: Panels split by draggable handles, over `react-resizable-panels`.

components.name: Masonry
components.description: A multi-column layout that balances items of uneven height, using CSS columns.

components.name: Theme Switcher
components.description: A light, dark and system control in three forms. Fully controlled — the app owns the theme state.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: A paged slide viewport with previous and next controls, over `embla-carousel-react`.

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: The Diametral logo as inline JSX, so it recolours with the surrounding text. Two lockups: horizontal and square.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: A stack of disclosure rows, one section per `AccordionItem`.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: One region that shows and hides. Use `Accordion` for several titled sections that stack.

components.name: Modal
components.description: The destructive-confirmation form of `Modal`: a heading, the consequence, and two buttons. Label the confirm button with the verb.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: Base UI's alert dialog, composed from parts. `Modal` stays the default for a confirmation.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.description: A right-click menu that opens at the pointer, for actions belonging to the item clicked.

components.name: Modal
components.description: A focused task on top of the page: heading, body, footer actions. Always controlled through `open` and `onClose`.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Base UI's dialog, composed from parts. `Modal` stays the default for a focused task.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: A menu of actions hanging off a trigger.

components.name: Hover Card
components.description: A preview panel shown on hover, for links and mentions. Keep anything essential on the page, since touch users never hover.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A small panel anchored to a trigger. Use it when the content is interactive; use `Tooltip` for a plain label.

components.name: Alert
components.description: An inline message about the content next to it. Use `Toast` for the result of an action.

components.name: Toast
components.description: A short confirmation that an action landed, raised from anywhere with `toast`. Mount `Toaster` once at the app root.

components.name: Bubble
components.description: Chat bubbles grouped by author. Use `Message` when a turn also needs an avatar or a timestamp.

components.name: Message
components.description: A conversation row with an avatar on one side and the content on the other, plus an optional header and footer.

components.name: Message Scroller
components.description: A transcript viewport that stays pinned to the newest message. Stylesheet only — the pinning needs your own binding.

components.name: Attachment
components.description: A chip showing a file's thumbnail, name and metadata. Display only; use `File Upload` to pick files.

components.name: Direction
components.description: A provider that sets text direction (LTR or RTL) for every Base UI component beneath it. Mount it once at the app root.

components.name: Chart
components.description: A thin frame around Recharts: series colours come from a `ChartConfig` and resolve to brand tokens.

components.name: Line Chart
components.description: A ready-made line chart — grid, axis, tooltip and legend wired from one `config`. Best for a value over time.

components.name: Area Chart
components.description: `Line Chart` with a filled band under each series, for when the size of the quantity matters. Same props.

components.name: Bar Chart
components.description: Bars comparing discrete categories, like revenue by quarter. Use `Line Chart` when the x axis is time.

components.name: Stacked Bar
components.description: Bars normalised to their own total, so the eye compares splits rather than sizes.

components.name: Pie Chart
components.description: A whole split into slices. Keep it to five or six; past that use `Bar Chart`.

components.name: Donut Chart
components.description: `Pie Chart` with the middle cut out, so a headline figure can sit in the hole.

components.name: Gauge
components.description: A radial dial for one bounded value, with optional thresholds that recolour the arc.

components.name: Sparkline
components.description: A tiny inline line chart with no axes, small enough to sit in every row of a table.

components.name: Radar Chart
components.description: A spider chart comparing two or three entities across many dimensions at once.

components.name: Combo Chart
components.description: Bars and a line on one x axis with a second Y scale — a volume series next to a rate.

components.name: Funnel Chart
components.description: Ordered conversion stages, with the drop-off computed from raw counts.

components.name: Scatter Chart
components.description: One quantity plotted against another, with optional bubble sizing for a third.

components.name: Treemap
components.description: A weighted hierarchy as nested areas. Use it where a pie has too many slices.

components.name: Waterfall Chart
components.description: Signed deltas accumulating from a starting value to a total.

components.name: Heatmap
components.description: Density across two axes shown as colour, built on CSS grid rather than a chart library.

components.name: Bullet Chart
components.description: A value against its target, with two or three qualitative bands behind it.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: The step rail of a multi-step flow: the steps, the one you are on, and how much is left.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: A vertical sequence of events, each completed, active or inactive.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A user image with initials behind it, plus a group form with an overflow count.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page links with previous, next and an ellipsis.

components.name: Agenda
components.description: Events sorted by day and time, grouped under day headings. Use it for what is coming up.

components.name: Table
components.description: The styled HTML table primitives, with no data layer. Use `Data Table` for sorting, filtering and paging.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: The trail to the current page, with the last item as plain text.

components.name: Empty
components.description: The empty-state block: media, title, description and an action.

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: A strip of grouped buttons, inputs and separators. It is one tab stop, with the arrow keys moving inside it.

components.name: Banner
components.description: A full-width, tone-coloured message bar for a whole page or section. Use `Alert` inside content.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Task completion advancing towards done, with optional label and value. `value={null}` is the indeterminate state.

components.name: Page Header
components.description: The top of a page: breadcrumb, title, description, actions, and an optional tab strip.

components.name: Description List
components.description: Term and detail pairs in a real `dl`, for record summaries.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: Renders a keyboard key inline, sized to the text around it. Use `KbdGroup` for a chord.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: An indeterminate loading indicator sized to the surrounding text. Use `Skeleton` when the shape of the content is known.

components.name: Icon
components.description: The built-in glyph set: 34 Phosphor icons keyed by name. Import from `@phosphor-icons/react` for anything outside it.

components.name: Button
components.description: The main action trigger. Eight variants and eight brand tones that combine freely.

components.name: Input
components.description: The single-line text field, and the base the other text controls borrow their focus and invalid styling from.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text field, measured in rows and sharing Input's focus and invalid states.

components.name: Field
components.description: The form row: label, control, description and error in one accessible group. Use it for every labelled control.

components.name: Select
components.description: A closed list for choosing one option, with a trigger and a portalled popup. Use `Combobox` once the list gets long.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A single yes-or-no control for a value a form submits. Use `Switch` for a setting that applies immediately.

components.name: Checkbox Group
components.description: Holds the array of values behind a set of checkboxes, including the select-all parent.

components.name: Switch
components.description: An on/off toggle for a setting that applies as soon as it changes.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Picks a number, or a range, by dragging along a track. Use `Number Field` when the exact figure matters.

components.name: Input Group
components.description: Puts icons, addons and buttons inside an input's own border.

components.name: Card
components.description: A bordered surface with header, content and footer slots. Use `Panel` for a flat region that belongs to the page.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A compact, uppercase status or category label with no box. `Tag` is the boxed, tinted version.

components.name: Status
components.description: A coloured dot and a word, for the state of one thing. Six tones.

components.name: Tag
components.description: A boxed, tinted label in six tones. Absorbs v1's Chip, whose `warn` boolean is now `tone="warning"`.

components.name: Panel
components.description: A flat, bordered section container — Card without the elevation — plus a row part for settings lists.

components.name: Kanban
components.description: A board of columns whose cards move between them by drag or by arrow key.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: A pulsing placeholder block for content that has not loaded yet.

components.name: Sheet
components.description: A panel that slides in from an edge, with Dialog's modal behaviour.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: A bottom sheet that follows the finger, with drag-to-dismiss and snap points. Tuned for touch.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short label shown on hover or focus. Never put interactive content in one.

blocks.name: Nav shell
blocks.description: Sidebar, grouped and nested nav, badges and an inset content area — the left edge of an application screen.

blocks.name: App chrome
blocks.description: Page header, toolbar, filter bar and stat band — the frame around an application screen.

blocks.name: Auth
blocks.description: Sign in, sign up, forgot-password and two-factor cards.

blocks.name: Marketing
blocks.description: Hero, feature grid, pricing, stat band and footer — built on the visible grid system.

blocks.name: Data & detail
blocks.description: Detail layout, empty state, faceted filter, activity feed and a confirmation dialog.

templates.name: Dashboard
templates.description: App bar, sidebar nav, KPI row and a chart panel — a full application screen.

templates.name: Login
templates.description: A standalone sign-in page, centered on the brand background.
A standalone error page built from the empty-state pattern.
